plan.title: Experience capture: per model/agent/role/version tracking with recency+version weighting
plan.goal: Extend agent-run-events with a dispatch->review->outcome->landing join, prompt/payload fingerprints and model identity, and read it through a decayed, version-weighted score used for advisory routing, reports and divergence alerts.
success_criteria: Reviewer role compared across two real models with joined outcomes and weighting (J1-J7)
Unknown/non-agent outcomes never change a score (learning-attribution gate)

items.name: Freeze PRD and owner decisions
items.goal: Independent scrutiny of formula and join design; owner answers decisions 1-9.

items.name: Emit lib with fingerprint and redaction
items.goal: experience_emit over make_event: prompt_sha256, template version, manifest hash, model params, quota_window type, redacted sidecar, fail-open kill switch.
items.validation_goal: Unit tests incl. synthetic-secret quarantine; real emit from one dispatch.

items.name: Wire delegate wrappers
items.goal: delegate-to-* and fanout emit events with dispatch_id==run_id, model id, tokens, wall time, quota windows.
items.validation_goal: Real dispatches on two lanes produce complete J1 chains.

items.name: Join review receipt and landing outcome
items.goal: aq-review-receipt review event; record_landing author_run_id, review_run_ids, redo/revert links; aq-land plumbing.
items.validation_goal: A real PR landing yields a full prompt->review->outcome->landing chain (J2).

items.name: Weighted experience cards
items.goal: experience_cards.py + config/experience-weighting.json implementing decay, version multiplier, shrinkage, confidence, LA gate.
items.validation_goal: Hand recomputation matches; unknown outcomes leave score unchanged; new version starts low-trust (J3-J5).

items.name: Rollup and retention
items.goal: Daily rollup and verified compression of raw events older than 90 days; no deletion.
items.validation_goal: Rollup totals equal raw totals for a real month; measured size drop; restore test.

items.name: Consumers: report, dashboard, hints, divergence alerts
items.goal: aq-report Experience section, dashboard route, advisory aq-hints line, divergence alert job.
items.validation_goal: Live aq-report and dashboard show real cards; alert path exercised (J6).

items.name: Cross-model replay and per-instance cards
items.goal: aq-prompt-eval --replay across lanes; optional routing weights after owner decision.
items.validation_goal: Replay on two lanes writes comparable experiment_id rows.

issues.note: Confirm telemetry work is allowed during system-integrity-recovery freeze (owner decision 1).
